title: S4 context pack
description: DRAFT 2026-11-16 (not frozen). The complete, frozen input one AI role sees for one decision. Built by code, never by a model. Stored whole in ai.context_pack; pack_hash = sha256 of the canonical JSON of this object without the pack_hash field (same rule as settings_snapshot.HASH.md: sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8). Rules the builder enforces and tests: (1) every item carries an id and a known_at, and known_at <= as_of, else the build fails; (2) a section with no data is null and its name is listed in absent with a reason, never defaulted; (3) no account id, login, secret, file path under the secrets folder, or currency balance: money appears only as R or percent of equity; (4) outside text appears only as Reader summaries, each at most 600 characters, never raw pages; (5) the serialized pack is at most 48,000 characters.

id.description: signal_id, or broker_trade_id for an open trade

as_of.description: The decision instant. Nothing known after it may be in the pack.

setup.description: The trade as proposed: pair, direction, entry, stop, target, exit_by, risk in R terms, reward:risk, timeframe, the probability object from the signal if present (unchanged).

strategy.description: Strategy key, card id, lifecycle stage, the rule in at most 600 characters, and its honest record: forward-ledger n and mean R with interval, backtest n and mean R, typical hold. Counts below 20 are shown as counts with no mean.

market.description: Numbers only: last close, ATR, distance to recent high/low in ATR, spread now and its 20-day median for this hour, realised volatility percentile, session.

events.description: Scheduled events inside the hold window and Reader-tagged items from the last 48 h that touch either currency or the index.

exposure.description: Open positions on this instance as pair, direction, strategy, R at risk; total open risk percent; same-currency and correlated risk percent; slots used.

data_quality.description: Age of the newest bar against its expected close, quarantine flags, missing bars in the lookback, feed heartbeat age.

position.description: position_monitor only: age, planned hold, R now, best and worst R so far, stop state, the ADR-004 trade-health verdict and E_rest if published.

brief.description: The latest daily brief rows for the instruments involved, with the brief's own id and known_at.
